title: TraceabilityRules
tracePath: canonical_id -> contract -> authority_class -> scope -> implementation_ref -> data_ref -> runtime_ref -> evidence_ref -> lifecycle -> version -> dependencies -> consumers -> conformance_status
rules: Every consequential operation should have an attributable principal and actor.
External events retain source identity and provenance.
Evidence is retained separately from claims and state.
Current state is a projection and is not the complete historical record.
Conflicting records are preserved, classified and resolved through governance.
Recovery must be possible from accepted canonical evidence where the underlying data permits.
